reasons.business: Niche, IP-adjacent audience; no monetisation path designed (no backend, no internet permission); exposure to Play's app-interference and FGS policies; no real-user evidence (rubric cap 6).
reasons.pmf: Only evidence is the owner's own trial (screenshots show day 8). The core stake can be removed by unlimited releases. Fit is plausible only for the Focus System, where the lock matches the habit.
reasons.technical: Pure-Dart domain, serialised writes, format and analyze clean, 211/211 tests, 80.3% line coverage. Kotlin enforcement layer has 0 tests and no integration_test; it has a P0 stale-state redirect trap, misses an app already open at lock start, trusts the device clock below API 33 and the device time zone everywhere, and runs its FGS 24/7.
reasons.uiux: Coherent, distinctive HUD theme, hold-to-confirm, honours reduced motion, 53 Semantics wrappers. About 110 text styles at 9-11 px, a 7-step onboarding with Settings detours, a rest period that can't be edited, an anxiety-first hidden lock start, weak store screenshots.
reasons.security: Data stays on device, no INTERNET, backup and transfer off, only the launcher activity exported, no tracked secrets. Privacy policy is wrong about FGS lifetime and log export; protected-apps list is India-only; self-cheat vectors (clock, zone, emptying the lock list) are logged at best.
reasons.behavioural: Safe after the latest fixes: exercise capped at the quest, no carry-over, stop rule, dry run, 21-of-30 Gate, reduction valve. But lock length grows with level with no cap, the start is unannounced, there is no dispute path, the S rank is a brittle 30-day streak, and unlimited releases weaken the commitment.
reasons.retention: Punitive core; first big reward (a Gate) comes at day 21 or later; no feedback on real-life outcomes, no social loop; no analytics or export, so retention can't even be measured.
reasons.publication: P0 open. No in-app privacy policy, thin prominent disclosure, FGS runs beyond what is necessary. FGS, Health and Data safety declarations and the 12-tester, 14-day closed test are not done. Store screenshots show a personal status bar.

findings.title: Native blocker stays armed after abandon/migration/unreadable save: every chosen-app launch is redirected to Do or Die indefinitely
findings.fix: Add AppBlocker.reset() (clear packages, lock, focus and judge day; stop the service) and call it on abandon, migration and the startup-error path. Natively, skip the judge redirect when no game exists. Give StartupErrorApp an export-and-reset action.
findings.acceptance: Dart test: abandon triggers reset. Kotlin/instrumentation test: no redirect with an empty state. Manual device check the next day after abandon.

findings.title: Lock not enforced on an app that is already open when the lock starts (first busy check reads only the last 10 s of events)
findings.fix: On each busy tick, work out the current foreground app from a longer lookback (30-60 min of events, or queryUsageStats last-used); seed lastEventQueryAt on the first busy tick.
findings.acceptance: With the app open across lock start, the block screen appears within 2 s (instrumentation or manual device test).

findings.title: Device clock is trusted below API 33 (minSdk 24) and when there is no network fix: setting the clock back rescues a failed day, setting it forward ends a lock
findings.fix: Persist a monotonic anchor (elapsedRealtime plus the last trusted wall time); never let 'today' fall behind the latest seen day; compute native lock state from the anchor. Or raise minSdk to 33.
findings.acceptance: Probe 3b no longer clears day 1; moving the clock forward does not end a native lock.

findings.title: Changing the time zone moves the day boundary (cheat, or a wrongful fail when travelling east); System Check ignores AUTO_TIME_ZONE
findings.fix: Store the zone offset with each issued day; a mid-day zone change can't extend the deadline and is logged; add an AUTO_TIME_ZONE check.
findings.acceptance: Test with the TZ changed mid-day: the deadline does not move later; System Check flags manual zone.

findings.title: Watcher foreground service runs 24/7 (5 s idle loop, 10 s heartbeat writes), contradicting the privacy policy and Play's 'only as long as necessary' FGS rule
findings.fix: Run the FGS only while a lock, focus block or pending judgement exists (start shortly before a scheduled lock via alarm or WorkManager); stop it otherwise; align the policy and declaration text.
findings.acceptance: No FGS on a penalty-free day; lock still enforced after reboot on a device.

findings.title: No in-app privacy policy; prominent disclosure for usage data and the installed-app list is a single line
findings.fix: Add a disclosure screen with Accept/Decline before GRANT naming the data, purpose and on-device storage; add a Privacy entry in Status showing the policy text.
findings.acceptance: Widget test: the disclosure appears before requestUsageAccess; the policy is reachable from Status.

findings.title: Unlimited 15-minute releases can release away an entire lock (16 releases for 240 min)
findings.fix: Bounded, escalating releases (for example 2 free, then a 30 s hold plus a reason, forfeiting the day's XP or Gate credit); keep an emergency exit always available.
findings.acceptance: Probe-2 variant: at least 75% of the lock is enforced unless the costly path is used; the exit still works.

findings.title: Native enforcement (about 1,000 Kotlin lines) has zero tests and there is no integration_test despite the project rules
findings.fix: Robolectric tests for BlockerState, UsageMeter and WatcherService.check; one emulator integration test of the lock flow.
findings.acceptance: These run in CI and cover the P0-1 and P1-1 regressions.

findings.title: Focus screen-time caps are measured on the lock list, which can be emptied: caps auto-clear and nothing is left to lock
findings.fix: Require at least one lock target while caps are in use; measure against a social-app category plus the list; removals take effect after a 7-day cooldown.

findings.title: No dispute or grace path for a wrongful verdict (phone died, bug, unmeasured cap)
findings.location: lib/app/game_service.dart (no such API); PROJECT.md section 7 promises one
findings.fix: One 'contest verdict' per 14 days within 2 h of judgement, with a logged reason; it cancels the lock and debt but keeps the fail record.
findings.acceptance: Service test plus a report line; the limit is enforced.

findings.title: Play prerequisites outstanding: FGS specialUse declaration and video, Health apps declaration, Data safety, closed test with 12 testers for 14 days, clean store screenshots
findings.fix: Complete the Console forms; recruit testers; retake screenshots with a demo status bar and a meaningful Penalty state.
findings.acceptance: Console shows all declarations complete; the closed test has run 14 days with 12 or more opted-in testers.

findings.title: Lock length scales with level with no cap (L10 = 420 min, L40 = 1,020 min, clamped to the whole waking day): punishes long-term success
findings.fix: Cap the lock (for example 4-6 h) or make it fixed; tune in config.

findings.title: Trial log export is not reachable from the UI (the privacy policy and PROJECT.md must-have #10 say it is)
findings.fix: Add a JSON/CSV export via the share sheet in Status or Report.
findings.acceptance: Widget test finds the export action; the file contains the full log.

findings.title: About 110 text styles at 9-11 px; dim mono on near-black hurts legibility
findings.fix: Body text at 12-13 sp or more; audit contrast; test at 200% font scale.
findings.acceptance: No text under 11 sp; golden tests at large font scale have no overflow.

findings.title: Rest period can't be changed after onboarding
findings.fix: Add an editor in Status, effective from tomorrow, logged.
findings.acceptance: Widget test edits the rest period; locks scheduled tomorrow respect it.

findings.title: Never-lock list is India-only banking; other critical apps (2FA, wallets, ride-hailing, health) are lockable
findings.fix: Let users mark apps as never-lock; add a category-based exclusion.
findings.acceptance: A user-marked app can't be added to the lock list.

findings.title: Diagnostics spike (start/stop lock) ships in release; a stopLock taken across midnight isn't re-pushed because of the enforcer cache
findings.fix: Hide it behind kDebugMode; invalidate the enforcer cache after any diagnostics action.
findings.acceptance: Release build has no diagnostics entry.

findings.title: Concept and copy close to the source anime ('You have met the conditions to become a Player', Penalty Zone, Daily Quest, Gates/Dungeons, E-S ranks)
findings.fix: IP review; rewrite signature lines; avoid source-identifying terms in the listing and marketing.

findings.title: PiP / background playback and browser versions of locked apps are not blocked
findings.fix: Device-test PiP and split-screen; document the limits in the terms; optionally suggest locking browsers.
findings.acceptance: Manual device checklist covers PiP, split-screen and browser.
